parsed_output.overall_summary: Sebastian Burka shares a critical technique adjustment for the chest fly exercise to improve muscle engagement and posture. He compares his old form, which involved excessive back arching and shoulder blade retraction, with his new form that focuses on ribcage expansion and a neutral spine. The video serves as a quick tutorial for gym-goers looking to optimize their chest workouts by avoiding common mechanical errors.

people.description: A bearded man in fitness attire (tank top, gym shorts, baseball cap) demonstrating exercise form.

takeaways.statement: To improve chest fly form, stop arching the lower back excessively against the seat.
Avoid over-retracting the shoulder blades during the movement.
Focus on ribcage expansion to better target the pectoral muscles.

items.name: Form Correction 1
items.details: Stop arching the back during the fly.

items.name: Form Correction 2
items.details: Stop retracting the scapula (shoulder blades) excessively.

items.name: Form Correction 3
items.details: Focus on ribcage expansion throughout the set.
